name: Ukiha (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ukiha city emblem in light blue: a stylised bird with outstretched wings and a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Ukiha, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 March 2005.

features.role: Ukiha city emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings and a disc
